proof_body:
by
  intro a d h n hn
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a m = a 1 + ((m : ℝ) - 1) * d := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ m hm ih =>
      rw [h m hm, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    rw [Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton]
    push_cast
    ring
  | succ n hn ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih, key n hn, key (n + 1) (by omega)]
    push_cast
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = a n + d) → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k = (n : ℝ) * (a 1 + a n) / 2
